cosmetic: The error banner and the Resume correction card show the same message twice. The message says "disabled" eight times and gives no model names or reasons, so it doesn't help the user.

Sidebar conversation titles and subtitles are cut off with an ellipsis (e.g. "Change the value to thre…", "Blocked · Browser fixture · dev-…"). This looks intentional and the full text likely shows elsewhere, but similar titles are hard to tell apart.
Some metadata text is small and low-contrast on the dark background: 'Local time', 'completed', 'Undone', 'Input'/'Output' labels and 'Step details'.
The correction tags (e.g. 'corrected: action → reply, effort → low') use small pink text on dark, which is hard to read.
'Step 1 · Implement' is struck through. This probably marks the step as undone, but it makes the label harder to read.
